title: Payment Speed Points for Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Prompt-Pay Charges
content:
**Training questions and answers — speed points on the prompt-pay rate, Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility.**

**How are speed points reckoned?** By a reckoning that depends on where the prompt-pay charge comes from — the category of the claim line the charge stems from, shown on the charge. The span is counted from the charge's posting date to the posting date of the payment that paid it.

| Charge stems from | Speed points added to the prompt-pay rate |
|---|---|
| a wheelchair line (Mobility Equipment), an oxygen line (Home Oxygen Therapy) or a PAP line (PAP Therapy Equipment) | 2 less one point for each full 8 calendar days in the span, never below zero |
| a PAP supply line (PAP Supply Replenishment Program) or a urological supply line (Urological Supply Program) | 2 less one point for each full 8 weekdays in the span, never below zero; the weekdays are taken as five sevenths (5 of every 7 days) of the calendar days, rounded down to a whole day |
| any other charge | none |

**Are the points a separate discount?** No — they are percentage points of the prompt-pay rate itself, which is applied once to the charge.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

| Charge stems from | Charge posted | Payment posted | Working | Points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| oxygen rental month | 1 May | 8 May | 7 days, no full 8 | 2 |
| oxygen rental month | 1 May | 9 May | 8 days, one full 8 | 1 |
| wheelchair rental month | 1 May | 17 May | 16 days, two full 8 | 0 |
| PAP supply shipment | 1 May | 13 May | 12 calendar days; five sevenths is 8.57, rounded down 8; one full 8 | 1 |
| urological supply shipment | 1 May | 11 May | 10 calendar days; five sevenths is 7.14, rounded down 7 | 2 |
| a hospital bed line (Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces) | 1 May | 3 May | another source | none |
